node.title: Ciclo exploración–explotación
node.summary: Read how a discovered difference can become repeatable and scale.

relations: The frontier cycle raises a governance question for compression and expansion: how can scaling retain the ability to explore without treating every expansion as extraction?
Son tipologías distintas. Ninguna permite clasificar automáticamente todo rollout como neutralización de la frontera.
A possible operational test is whether selective decoupling preserves room for exploration while reducing coordination that blocks action across the network.
Hipótesis propuesta. La fricción no es siempre aprendizaje ni un menor acoplamiento mejora cualquier sistema.
The invisible-talent model offers a useful counterpoint to symbolic celebration: capability remains alive through formation, operational missions and opportunities to exercise judgment.
No se afirma que el caso de formación haya sido diseñado para resolver el ciclo descrito por LatinoEmpresa.
The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.
Aplicación propuesta; el protocolo no se ha validado aquí para comunidades de frontera ni se asignan puntuaciones a personas.
The watchmaking case suggests a practical distinction between commemorating inherited know-how and keeping it usable within a federated operating architecture.
Analogía entre contextos; preservar maestría no exige conservar cada proceso, sistema o coste histórico.
